description:
Quabble: Daily Mental Health
Ease anxiety & lift mood

Reduce stress, anxiety, and depression with joyful daily self-care routines. Quabble offers a wide range of therapist-backed mental health practices to support your well-being. With your Quabble Duck by your side, caring for your mental health becomes a natural and uplifting part of every day.

All-in-One Mental Health App
Developed by people who understand real-life challenges, Quabble brings evidence-based practices and mindfulness training into one easy-to-use app. No more juggling multiple apps for meditation, journaling, sleep, or emotional support, Quabble helps you manage it all in one calming place.

Why users love Quabble
98% say it helps manage mental health
87% report improved well-being
10 million+ wellness routines completed

What You’ll Find Inside

Therapist-Backed Workouts
Practice CBT-inspired grounding, positive affirmations, gratitude reflection, and mindfulness meditation to strengthen six key areas of wellness: Emotional Regulation, Physical Health, Sleep, Mindfulness, Social Support, and Personal Growth.

Daily Mini-Routines & Habit Tracker
Start mornings with intention and end with reflection. The First Bloom Journey 15-day program helps you build sustainable self-care habits, track progress, and celebrate growth with small rewards.

Your Virtual Park
Design a calm sanctuary that mirrors your journey. Decorate with flowers and cozy decos, dress your Duck in cute outfits, and invite friendly animal companions.

Support for Anxiety & Depression
Use science-based tools like 54321 Grounding, 1-Minute Breathing, Pleasant Activities, Safe Place, Tai Chi, and the Calm-Down Kit to ease panic, stress, and racing thoughts between therapy sessions.

A Caring Community
Share thoughts in the Bamboo Forest and connect with others who truly understand—judgment-free. Write letters to your past or future self, or create a personal Safe Place for reflection.

Track Your Progress
Visual insights across six pillars of mental health help you understand patterns in mood, sleep, mindfulness, and overall wellness.

Beautiful & Relaxing Design
Praised for its soothing visuals, Quabble makes practicing mindfulness, relaxation, and emotional balance feel easy and aesthetic.

Some of Quabble’s Most Loved Workouts

Gratitude Jar
Boost resilience and positivity with daily gratitude reflections.

Mood Diary
Track emotions and notice patterns to strengthen emotional regulation.

Moonlight
Drift into better sleep with soothing sounds and mindful relaxation.

Safe Place
Create a calm mental sanctuary for stress relief and anxiety support.

54321 Grounding
A therapist-recommended tool to ease panic and racing thoughts.

Proud Dandelion
Build confidence and self-esteem by celebrating daily victories.

Treasure Box
Capture joyful memories to balance mood and boost optimism.

Worry Box
Let go of what’s beyond your control and create emotional calm.

Mindful Meditation
A three-minute mindfulness reset for clarity and focus.

Watermelon Tai Chi
Gentle movement and deep breathing for mind-body balance.

…and more. Quabble offers 18 unique therapist-backed workouts across six key areas of wellness, with new ones added regularly to keep your self-care journey fresh.

Join Quabble Club

Unlock premium features:
• Exclusive workouts and tools
• Unlimited insights with Wellness Radar
• Expanded community support in Bamboo Forest
• Automatic weather and day/night sync
• 300 free hearts each month
Plans: $8.99/month or $49.99/year ($4.16/month).
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled 24 hours before renewal in Account Settings.
